other_failure_modes.name: Destructive categorical coercion
other_failure_modes.description: The agent forces all non-target columns to numeric using `pd.to_numeric(..., errors='coerce')`, which replaces any string-based categorical values with NaNs. This destroys the information in those features before imputation.

summary: The solution is generally well-structured and follows good practices for time-series validation, feature engineering, and avoiding data leakage. However, it exhibits a few minor failure modes: evaluating stochastic models with a single seed, relying on manually hardcoded weights for ensembling without optimization, and destructively coercing potential string categoricals to numeric.
